name: BrickTracker
description: A web application for organizing and tracking LEGO sets, parts, and minifigures. Uses the Rebrickable API to fetch LEGO data and allows users to track missing pieces and collection status.

paths.name: Database Path
paths.description: Path to the SQLite database. Run `touch app.db` BEFORE running container for the first time.

variables.name: Rebrickable API Key
variables.description: API key for Rebrickable. Get one at https://rebrickable.com/api/

variables.name: Domain Name
variables.description: Domain name for the application. Replace with local IP address or domain name.

variables.name: Password
variables.description: Password for the application. Useful if you want to share the page with other in read-only.

variables.name: Authentication Key
variables.description: A unique key used to sign the secrets when using authentication. Remove if not using Password. Use Python command: python3 -c 'import secrets; print(secrets.token_hex())'

variables.description: Display Bricklink links wherever applicable

variables.name: Part Link Pattern (BrickLink)
variables.description: Pattern of the link to Bricklink for a part. Will be passed to Python .format(). Supports {part} and {color} parameters. BrickLink part numbers and color IDs are used when available.

variables.name: Part Link Pattern
variables.description: Pattern of the link to Rebrickable for a part. Will be passed to Python .format()

variables.name: Missing Part Image

variables.name: Set Link Pattern
variables.description: Pattern of the link to Rebrickable for a set. Will be passed to Python .format()

variables.name: Themes URL
variables.description: URL to the themes.csv.gz on Rebrickable

variables.name: Use Remote Images
variables.description: Use remote image rather than the locally stored ones. Also prevents downloading any image when adding sets.

variables.name: Timestamp Format
variables.description: Format of the timestamp added to the database file when downloading it

variables.name: Rebrickable API User Agent
variables.value: 'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/91.0.4472.124 Safari/537.36'
variables.description: User agent to use when making requests to Rebrickable. This is used to prevent being rate limited.
